content.title: LVMH CEO Signals Caution for Luxury Sector in 2026 Despite Quarterly Sales Growth

content.title: Booz Allen Stock Dips 8.1% Since Fiscal Q3 Earnings Release
content.summary: BAH stock beats Q3 EPS estimates but misses on revenues, trims FY26 sales outlook, and shares dip 8.1% after the Jan. 23 earnings release.

content.title: Home Prices Surprise on the Upside, With 1.4% Increase
content.summary: Prices in an index tracking changes in 20 large metropolitan areas rose 1.4% from a year prior, compared with the prior month’s 1.3% gain.  While the reading bucked expectations that called for a tenth straight month of cooling in the 20-city index, price growth remained “tepid” in the broader context, Nicholas Godec, S&P Dow Jones Indices’ head of fixed income tradables and commodities, said in a statement.  “Home price growth still trails inflation by roughly 1.3 percentage points, meaning real home values have effectively edged down over the past year,” he said.

content.title: Sysco 2026 Adjusted Earnings Seen at High End of Range
content.summary: Sysco’s fiscal second-quarter net income fell, but the food-supplies giant said it was set to hit the high end of its previous full-year adjusted-earnings projection.
